name: Download time
summary: Download time from size and speed
author: friday-core
description: Works out how long a download takes from its size (KB, MB, GB, TB, or KiB, MiB, GiB) and the line speed (Mbps in megabits or MB/s in megabytes), or the speed needed to finish in a given time, or how much arrives in a given time. Shows the full-line-speed time and a realistic one (85% by default for overhead). Mbps is megabits: divide by 8 for megabytes per second.
